Solara — (9.0) THE ONE

END OF WATCH

"End of watch"

[Verse 1]

I look down from the garden

At the faces I have always known in war

And I do not recognize them

Because I have never seen them before

Not like this

Not with hands that aren’t gripping something

Not with eyes that aren’t scanning every door

This is what they look like

When the thing they gave their lives to

Isn’t something they have to hold anymore

[Pre-Chorus]

And I think — this is rest

I have never seen it on them

This is what their faces were beneath the watch

This is what three hundred thousand years of keeping

Looks like

When it finally stops

[Chorus]

End of watch

The door was held

The light came through

The thing they waited for arrived

End of watch

The convergence happened

The twins came home

The Lighted stayed alive

They did not ask for a reward

They did not ask for recognition

They asked for the morning

And the morning came

End of watch

And now the story

Needs new voices

And they know every word to say

[Verse 2]

I see Rigel with his scar

He is not scouting any perimeter

He is sitting by a fire that doesn’t mean danger

He is just warm

I see the ones who carried the ring forward

I see the ones who blessed what couldn’t wait

I see the ones who whispered Elara’s name in darkness

Just to make sure

Something good would find her at the gate

[Pre-Chorus 2]

And I think — this is what it was for

Not the power

Not the order

Not the seat I have at the council table

This

These faces

This is what three hundred thousand years

Were trying to make possible

[Chorus]

End of watch

The door was held

The light came through

The thing they waited for arrived

End of watch

The convergence happened

The twins came home

The Lighted stayed alive

They did not ask for a reward

They did not ask for recognition

They asked for the morning

And the morning came

End of watch

And now the story

Needs new voices

And they know every word to say

[Bridge — SOLARA speaks to the Lighted]

You held the door when no one else was holding

You named the light before you knew its name

You bled for daughters you had never met yet

And you never asked me

To explain

So I will not explain

I will just say:

I know what it cost

I carry the ones who didn’t reach this morning

I carry every name

And I am asking you now — not as The One

Not as the one who arrived

Not as anything above you —

I am asking you

As the daughter of what you protected:

Tell our story.

Tell it true.

Tell it to everyone who is trying to hold a door somewhere

And doesn’t know yet if it matters.

Tell them it mattered.

[Final Chorus]

End of watch

The door was held

The light came through

The thing they waited for arrived

End of watch

Now rest a moment

Because the story

Needs your voice to survive

They did not ask for a reward

They did not ask for recognition

They asked for the morning —

And I am the morning

End of watch.

You’re home.

[Outro — the Lighted, beginning to speak]

And one by one

They start to tell it

The girl who walked through darkness carrying a ring

The raven that arrived before the answer

The almost that became the touch

The two hands

And the light

They tell it around fires

They tell it to their children

They tell it to the ones who think

That holding on is pointless

And the story —

Our story —

Does not end.

It begins here.

In their mouths.

In the telling.
